comment: Read from src/Resonators.cpp at commit fb01326, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.11.1. The manual is written for 2.11.0 and says nothing about this module that the code contradicts. Two things it leaves out. The AMP knob scales only what reaches the OUT jack; the WET jack carries the four resonators at their GAIN settings alone (Resonators.cpp:246 against 250). And the polyphonic CV jacks fall back to their last channel rather than to zero when they carry fewer than four channels (Resonators.cpp:183, 195 and 205), so a monophonic cable into DECAY, COLOR or GAIN moves all four resonators. The COLOR figures come from Resonators.cpp:197 to 234: the knob is turned into a factor of 100 to the power of twice the knob minus one, which multiplies a 20000Hz lowpass and a 20Hz highpass, both clamped to 20Hz and 20000Hz.
